function.arguments: {"reflection":"The first search returned four highly relevant benchmark sources. SRC-001 is an official U.S. Rewards for Justice page with an explicit RaaS characterization, operating facts, scale, extortion method, aliases, and government-linked assessment, but it does not identify legal names. SRC-004 is an official DOJ case hub updated July 8, 2026, documenting defendants, case numbers, charges, plea, and presumption of innocence. SRC-002 is a secondary technical analysis of original ContiLeaks chats, with caveats that some files were encrypted and access credentials were not used; it offers internal communications, business funding, infrastructure, developer, and operational evidence. SRC-003 is a secondary CIS analysis summarizing leak-based organizational roles, staffing, budgets, and commercialization. Need narrower searches for official indictments/sanctions and more detailed leak analyses, especially exact aliases and attribution."}
